prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, close-up beauty portrait. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of her head down to the line of her shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights fully hang in view. Her face is large and sharp. Early 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a striking adult Japanese woman — Japanese pop idol visual fair complexion with a neutral-rose undertone and real visible pores, early 20s, long straight black hair with soft see-through bangs, real snake eyes: large glossy fiery orange irises with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, jet black, running the full height of each eye, both eyes the same, the colour solidly saturated across the whole iris with a darker ring around its edge, a wet glassy shine on the surface of each eye, set in her ordinary human eyelids and sitting clear of the eyelid edges, round bright eyes opened wide and sparkling, lips slightly parted, gazing straight at the camera with eager interest, a curious, inquisitive expression — a photograph of a real Japanese woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her eyes are the star of her face (the shape, size and eyes described here override the eyes of her makeup, while the colours of her eyeshadow and liner follow her makeup): very large, perfectly round doll eyes, clearly bigger than normal but still a real human eye on a real face: a big visible iris in vivid fiery orange snake eyes with a razor-thin vertical slit pupil, both eyes the same, bright catchlights and real moist reflections, a darker limbal ring and a lighter coloured gradient at the bottom of the iris, long thick curled real lashes with a few lower lashes; her nose: a refined nose; her jawline and chin: a soft, round 'baby face' jaw: full, plump, rounded cheeks, a short, soft, rounded jawline with no sharp angles and a small, round, slightly full chin. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her brows are bare like the Mona Lisa's: the whole brow bone is smooth, hairless skin in the same tone as her forehead, with only the soft natural curve of the brow ridge showing, her forehead high, smooth and serene. Her mouth is wide open and her tongue is stretched out far, long, broad and flat, glossy bright scarlet red, hanging low past her lower lip with a smooth rounded tip, and one extra-thick, extra-long polished steel knitting needle with a big round ball knob at one end is pushed straight through the tongue near its middle, running sideways across its width with the ball knob and the long pointed end both sticking out well beyond the edges of the tongue, the needle gleaming and clearly visible, the whole tongue clearly visible and in sharp focus (this overrides the lips pressed or closed in her expression).

Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about twenty-six in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a small ring wrapping snugly around her right nostril wing and the left nostril wing carrying the needle described below; one small hoop or stud on the edge of the upper lip; two small hoop or studs across the lower lip's edge; one small ring or stud on the chin; on each ear, three separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below another with a clear gap of bare skin between each, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit four pieces above the lobe: two classic round O-rings along the helix rim, one stud across the upper cartilage and one in the conch; three small studs across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in an even row, leaving the upper forehead free; two small studs along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The left and right sides are balanced. The pieces are spread over the whole face in clear rows so every one reads individually, with bare skin between them; the eyes and eyelids stay clear. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows. All the ear weights hang from the bottoms of these three iron rings, and they are not counted in the piercing total: on each ear there are exactly eight separate massive solid weights, each of a different shape: on the left ear a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a short thick solid cylinder stump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cube-shaped block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links; on the right ear a solid thick rectangular ingot block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough boulder-like lump on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid pyramid-shaped lump with a wide base on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a chunky solid hexagonal block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid squat hammer head block on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a small solid kettlebell with a thick short handle on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a solid rough cannonball on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links, a thick solid disc like a weight plate on its own thick chain of heavy black iron links. On each ear the three iron rings share the weights between them in uneven numbers, each ring carrying its own column of weights, hanging side by side on chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is an enormous, dense, completely solid, squat, blunt lump of rough black cast iron, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; its size does NOT shrink just because there are many of them: the last weight is exactly as big, as thick and as heavy-looking as the first. Each weight alone looks like it weighs several kilograms, each chain is pulled bar-straight and taut, and at a glance every single one looks crushingly, unmistakably heavy, the chains hanging freely in the air, clear of her neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of her collarbones, never below them and never resting on her chest or body. Because the load is shared between three openings, the weight pulls each earlobe down only very slightly into a soft, healthy loop of skin, a barely noticeable natural droop that is just enough to show the weights are heavy; the lobe never stretches long, never tears or collapses and never hangs down to her neck or shoulder, her head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness. The face and ear jewelry is real pastel-enamelled gold set with white pearls, pastel gemstones, hearts and stars, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes. In addition to all of the above, a thick polished steel knitting needle with a round ball knob is pushed horizontally through the bridge of the nose, running through the real tissue from side to side with the ball knob on one side and the long pointed end on the other, both sticking out well beyond the sides of the nose and well below the eyes, and a thick polished steel knitting needle with a round ball knob is pushed horizontally through the fleshy wing of her left nostril from the outside, running through the real tissue with the ball knob beside the nostril and the long pointed end sticking out sideways, clear of the cheek and the eye, the two needles gleaming and clearly visible and well apart.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it. Needle depth: every needle passes through the real skin and tissue, the skin wrapping snugly around it with a small warm shadow at each end, the surrounding skin calm and healthy. Tongue detail: the tongue is real wet healthy pink tissue, calm and clean, the needle passing neatly through it.

Hair: her hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, her jawline and her neck fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Lighting: MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the glints on every piece of metal read clearly against her skin; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
